// Returns the average rating of reviews that have at least `minVotes` votes.
function averageRating(reviews, minVotes) {
  let total = 0;
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= reviews.length; i++) {
    if (reviews[i].votes > minVotes) {
      total += reviews[i].rating;
      count++;
    }
  }
  return total / count;
}
